Coram : RAJENDRA MAL LODHA*, C.K. PRASAD
Penal Code, 1860: A B s.302134 and s.300, Exception 4 - Ingredients of - c Explained - Held: Evidence discloses that when the victim abused the accused, two of them brought weapons and lathi and attacked the victim - Thus, the accused had sufficient time to cool down and, therefore, it cannot be in a heat of passion - Further, deceased being 0 an old man had merely abused the accused, verbal abuses are not fight - Therefore, this ingredient is also not satisfied - High Court erred in holding the convicts guilty u/s.304 (Part- //) - Judgment of High Court, in so far as it altered
Decision Date : 23-08-2013 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1249/2013 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
